page.overview:
What is Aamaarazan homeworld?

The Aamaarazan homeworld was the home planet of the Aamaarazans. This planet was located in the Alpha Quadrant. In 3196, during the Omega-47 crisis, the location of "Aamaarazan Homeworld" was depicted on star charts and readouts used across several locations on the to locate, monitor, and respond to the Omega-47 mines laid by the Venari Ral. This location was one of the few labeled with a star. ()
